source_sentence: manipulating a number of variables relating to people's ability to influence others

source_sentence: serves as a solution to marketing problems

source_sentence: requires solid evidence for its validity

review_note: validity 常和 evidence/theory/argument 搭配，用来谈“是否有充分依据”。

source_sentence: The eagerness to be accepted

review_note: eagerness 比 desire 更强调“急切、热切”。

source_sentence: The impulse to influence others

source_sentence: The inclination to rely on others

tags: 写作友好|议论文常用|心理态度|选项词

source_sentence: the accounting standard-setters

source_sentence: enormous losses

review_note: enormous losses = 巨额亏损。

source_sentence: it's just not fair

review_note: assets 常和 value/report/losses 等财务语境搭配。

source_sentence: is hugely unrealistic

tags: 阅读高频|程度副词|Text4-S10
review_note: 先抓表语 unrealistic 再回填程度。

source_sentence: is hugely unrealistic
usage: unrealistic 表示与现实情况不符；不是“不清晰”或“无意识”。
tags: 阅读高频|观点态度|易混表达|Text4-S10
review_note: un- 否定 realistic“现实的”。

source_sentence: According to several studies
usage: study 作名词可表示研究；复数 studies 在本句指若干研究而不是 stories“故事”。
tags: 阅读高频|学术表达|易混表达|Text4-S11
review_note: 根据 according to 后的证据语境判断为研究。

source_sentence: studies concluding that parents are less happy
usage: concluding that 是现在分词短语后置修饰 studies；不是全句谓语。
tags: 阅读高频|非谓语|学术表达|Text4-S11
review_note: 全句主句谓语是 are；先跳过分词短语抓主干。

source_sentence: parents are less happy than childless couples
meaning: 不如……幸福；比……幸福程度低
usage: less happy 是比较级；只说明相对程度更低，不等于 unhappy“完全不幸福”。

source_sentence: single parents are the least happy of all
meaning: 在所有人中幸福程度最低
usage: the least happy 是最高级；of all 给出比较范围。
tags: 阅读高频|最高级|逻辑边界|Text4-S11
review_note: 仍是幸福程度比较；不必机械译成“最不高兴”。

source_sentence: No shock there
meaning: 这并不令人震惊；这不足为奇
usage: 省略表达；there 回指前一句单亲父母幸福程度最低这一结果。
tags: 阅读高频|省略表达|观点态度|Text4-S12
review_note: 先回前文找 there 所指的结论。

source_sentence: considering how much work it is
usage: considering 引出判断依据；相当于 given that 或 when one considers。
tags: 阅读高频|原因背景|逻辑连接|Text4-S12

source_sentence: without a partner to lean on

source_sentence: yet to hear Sandra and Britney tell it

source_sentence: to hear Sandra and Britney tell it

source_sentence: raising a kid on their own

tags: 阅读高频|固定搭配|观点态度|Text4-S12
review_note: 代词 their 指 Sandra and Britney；不是指孩子自己。

source_sentence: read: with round-the-clock help
usage: 括号中的 read: 用来改写或揭示前面说法的真实含义；不是普通“阅读”。
tags: 阅读识别|媒体表达|讽刺语气|Text4-S12

source_sentence: with round-the-clock help

source_sentence: is a piece of cake

source_sentence: contributes little to the glamour

source_sentence: the glamour of celebrity moms

source_sentence: our dissatisfaction with life

source_sentence: want children just because

source_sentence: stress-free parenthood

source_sentence: happiness-enhancing parenthood

source_sentence: in some small subconscious way

source_sentence: the actual experience

source_sentence: in the same way that a small part of us hoped

source_sentence: might make us look just a little bit like Jennifer Aniston

source_sentence: peer pressure often emerges as

source_sentence: a stimulus to group dynamics; the power of group dynamics

source_sentence: half invitation and half forcing

source_sentence: peer pressure can also be a positive force
